name: GTCRN · speech enhancement
attribution: Xiaobin-Rong/gtcrn, exported for sherpa-onnx by k2-fsa
description: Takes the room off a recording before the decoder hears it: fans, air conditioning, keyboard, traffic through a window. Half a megabyte, and it runs over each finished sentence rather than the live audio. Worth having in a noisy room and worth leaving off in a quiet one — on clean speech from a good microphone it removes things that were not noise, and the transcript gets slightly worse rather than better.
